paragraphs.text: We report a sol-gel route to a LiFePO4/C composite cathode that delivers a discharge capacity of 158 mAh/g at 0.1 C.
LiFePO4 is a widely studied olivine cathode material for lithium-ion batteries.
The LiFePO4/C composite was prepared by a sol-gel method using commercial carbon black as the carbon source.
At 0.1 C the composite delivered 158 mAh/g, outperforming the hydrothermal reference sample, which gave 141 mAh/g under the same rate.
